"""ex05 记忆遗忘：LRU 容量淘汰 + TTL 逻辑时钟过期（不使用 time.time()）。"""
from collections import OrderedDict

TICK = 0


def tick():
    global TICK
    TICK += 1
    return TICK


class Memory:
    def __init__(self, capacity, ttl):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.ttl = ttl
        self.store = OrderedDict()      # key -> (value, written_tick)
        self.hits = 0
        self.misses = 0
        self.evicted = 0
        self.expired = 0

    def purge_expired(self, now):
        dead = [k for k, (_, t) in self.store.items() if now - t >= self.ttl]
        for k in dead:
            del self.store[k]
            self.expired += 1

    def put(self, key, value, now):
        self.purge_expired(now)
        if key in self.store:
            del self.store[key]
        elif len(self.store) >= self.capacity:
            self.store.popitem(last=False)      # LRU：淘汰最久未使用
            self.evicted += 1
        self.store[key] = (value, now)

    def get(self, key, now):
        self.purge_expired(now)
        if key not in self.store:
            self.misses += 1
            return None
        self.hits += 1
        v, t = self.store.pop(key)
        self.store[key] = (v, t)                # 命中即移到最新
        return v

    def keys(self):
        return list(self.store.keys())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # 阶段一：LRU（ttl 很大，不发生过期）
    lru = Memory(capacity=3, ttl=100)
    for k in ("A", "B", "C"):
        lru.put(k, "v" + k, tick())
    lru.get("A", tick())          # 命中 A
    lru.put("D", "vD", tick())    # 容量满 -> 淘汰 B
    lru.get("B", tick())          # 未命中（已被淘汰）
    lru.get("C", tick())          # 命中 C
    lru.put("E", "vE", tick())    # 淘汰 A
    lru.get("D", tick())          # 命中 D
    print("[LRU] 命中=%d 未命中=%d 容量淘汰=%d 最终键=%s"
          % (lru.hits, lru.misses, lru.evicted, lru.keys()))

    # 阶段二：TTL（容量充足，只验证过期）
    ttl = Memory(capacity=10, ttl=5)
    ttl.put("X", "vX", 10)
    ttl.put("Y", "vY", 12)
    ttl.purge_expired(16)         # X 已存活 6 > 5 过期；Y 存活 4 仍在
    print("[TTL] 过期=%d 最终键=%s" % (ttl.expired, ttl.keys()))

    print("LRU 淘汰了最久未使用项 = %s" % (lru.evicted == 2))
    print("TTL 过期了超期项 = %s" % (ttl.expired == 1))
